categories.name: Cylinders / Cores
categories.sub: Keys Each values used in OET for cylinder & core line items

items.name: Change Key (CK)
items.notes: Standard default. 2 cut keys ship with each cylinder.

items.name: SKD (Single Keyed Different)
items.notes: Gets its own unique change key. Same default as CK.

items.name: NMK (Not Master Keyed)
items.notes: Keyed to specific symbol but excluded from master hierarchy.

items.name: Master Key Cylinder
items.notes: Ships with 0 keys. Masters ordered on separate cut key line.

items.name: Grand Master Cylinder
items.notes: Same as master — keys ordered separately.

items.name: GGM / TMK Cylinder
items.notes: Keys ordered separately.

items.name: Selective Master Cylinder
items.notes: Keys ordered separately.

items.name: X13X Cross-Keyed (no own key)
items.notes: No key symbol of its own → no keys to ship.

items.name: XAA1 Cross-Keyed (HAS own key)
items.notes: Has own change key symbol → gets keys for that symbol.

items.name: X-Prefix + Symbol
items.notes: Pinning identical to base symbol. X documents cross-keying. Keys included.

items.name: KA (Keyed Alike)
items.notes: 2 per cylinder default. Customer often specifies total per group.

items.name: LKB (Less Key Blank)
items.notes: Explicitly no keys ship. Cylinder pinned but no physical keys.

items.name: Construction Key (CK Split Key)
items.notes: Furnished WITHOUT keys. Must add operating + control key manually.

categories.name: Cut Key Line Items
categories.sub: Quantities per symbol when ordering keys on a separate line

items.name: Master Key
items.notes: Believed to be 2 per symbol.

items.name: Grand Master Key
items.notes: Needs verification.

items.name: GGM / TMK
items.notes: Needs verification.

items.name: Selective Master
items.notes: Needs verification.

items.name: Control Key (FSIC/SFIC)
items.notes: Believed 1 per system, not per cylinder.

items.name: Control Key (7-pin)
items.notes: Same question as standard control.

items.name: Construction Operating Key
items.notes: Must be manually added.

items.name: Construction Control Key
items.notes: Must be manually added.

items.name: Emergency Key
items.notes: Need to determine standard default.

items.name: Sub-Master Key
items.notes: Needs verification.

items.name: Key Blanks (uncut)
items.notes: No standard default — qty per customer order.

items.name: Extra Cut Keys
items.notes: Debit/credit balance items.

items.name: PKI (Pack Keys Independently)
items.notes: Service charge, not a key quantity.
